sources.title: Checklist for new phone or broadband contract
sources.evidence_location: official HTML contract-duration and customer-scope sections
sources.geography: United Kingdom residential and small-business customers
facts: The guidance applies to residential and small-business customers with 10 employees or fewer
Providers must offer an option no longer than 12 months for each service
Residential and small-business service contracts should be no longer than 24 months
Rolling, 12-month, 18-month and 24-month terms are discussed
limitations: Contract guidance does not prove network availability
Provider terms and address eligibility require current verification
